document_conflicts.description: Chapter 4 preferred-sites list says 'Bulk Creek Solar Site'; its substantive project chapter, Schedule 8, Schedule 9, and Schedule 10 use 'Bull Creek'.
Narrative refers to May 2034 retirement, while Schedule 1 and Schedule 8 use June 2034.
Schedule 8 and Schedule 9 materially disagree on the planned CT group's seasonal capacity.

extraction_notes: Schedule 8 additions were reconciled to Schedule 9 facility sheets and Chapter 4 preferred-site descriptions where named projects overlapped.

Every Schedule 8 construction, commercial-service, retirement, upgrade, contract expiration, and solar-degradation row represented above has a corresponding plan event, except individual construction/commercial-service events for proposed resources that are stored in project timelines but omitted from the event array due to output-size limitations.

The document identifies 27 existing DEF-owned solar facilities in Schedule 1 and Chapters 3.54-3.56. They are not restated as individual entities here because the supplied output concentrates entity-level records on future actions, existing assets with scheduled changes, and separately identified pilot storage assets.
unresolved_items: Storage-energy MWh values are not supplied for the five TBD BESS groups planned for 2029, 2030, and 2034.
The locations and interconnection facilities for all TBD solar, storage, and CT planning groups remain unspecified.
Existing generation assets without a planning-period change, including the full Schedule 1 fleet, should be loaded separately if a complete baseline asset register is required.
normalization_notes: Derived 65 plan event(s) from normalized entity timeline fields.
Skipped 9 historical commercial-service milestone(s) that predate the document planning period.
Skipped 1 contract retirement milestone(s) because contract timeline dates must not be automatically interpreted as physical asset retirements.
